title: Discovery Memo
description: Output of the Discovery Agent (DA). Uses secondary synthesis sources to flag coverage gaps and suggest candidate headings. NOT ontology-eligible. Cannot be the basis for final code selection.

suggested_candidate_headings.description: Headings noted in secondary sources as plausibly applicable. For human consideration, not final selection.

discovery_rationale.description: Explanation of why these headings were noted — which source and why

confidence_note.description: ALWAYS this value. DA records cannot be promoted or used as sole classification basis.

poor_pta_coverage.description: True if secondary sources suggest the heading text is ambiguous for this component

novel_product_type.description: True if the component is a recently emerged product type with limited tariff schedule coverage

industry_debate_noted.description: True if secondary sources document ongoing industry or customs authority debate on classification

source_doc.description: Exact filename from source_repo/corpus/ (secondary sources only)
